# OneAI Hub — Privacy Policy

_Last updated: 2026-04-01_

## 1. What this dashboard stores

This admin dashboard stores only metadata required to operate the platform:

- User account identifiers (email, signup date, platform)
- Aggregated request and token counts per user
- Subscription and billing metadata
- Support ticket metadata (subject, status, priority)

We do **not** store conversation content, message bodies, attachments, or any user-generated text. If a user attaches a conversation to a support ticket, the attachment is held for 30 days and then permanently deleted.

## 2. Who can see what

- The super-admin sees metadata only.
- The super-admin can extend, suspend, or reactivate accounts with a documented reason.
- Every action is recorded in an append-only audit log.

## 3. Upstream providers

User prompts are forwarded to upstream AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Perplexity). Their privacy policies apply to the data they receive.

## 4. Cookies and analytics

This dashboard sets a single session cookie (`admin_session`) used to keep you signed in. We do not use third-party analytics or tracking cookies.

## 5. Data retention

- Audit log entries are retained for 7 years for compliance.
- Support ticket metadata is retained for 2 years after closure.
- User account records are retained for 30 days after deletion, then permanently removed.

## 6. Your rights

End users may request export or deletion of their metadata by emailing privacy@oneai.app. We respond within 30 days.

## 7. Changes to this policy

Changes are published as a new version of this document. The current version is identified at the top of this page.

## 8. Contact

privacy@oneai.app
